calibration.data_class: instrument calibration; reported in full whether it passes or fails

iota_development.assignment: for grid point index g (coarse 0-9, bisection 10-15, final 16) and run index r: run_seed = 10000000 + 25000*g + r
iota_development.streams: medium RNG = numpy PCG64 seeded with the integer formed by the first 8 bytes (big-endian) of SHA-256 of ASCII 'ICP-DP-PERSISTENCE-001' + NUL + 'medium' + NUL + decimal run_seed; dynamics RNG identical with 'dynamics'
iota_development.capacity_check: 25000 seeds per point exceeds the largest registered run count (20000)
iota_development.use: coarse grid, bisection, final point, H1 to H3
iota_development.medium_draw: draw L^3 uniform variates from the run's medium stream in one call, indexed in lexicographic (x, y, z) order; a site is fresh iff its variate < rho; the seed site's variate is drawn and discarded; run seeds differ across grid points, so points are statistically independent

iota_confirmation.assignment: run_seed = 20000000 + 25000*j + r, j = 0 (bracket lower endpoint), 1 (final point), 2 (bracket upper endpoint)
iota_confirmation.registered_endpoint: at the three development-frozen rho values: lower endpoint subcritical, upper endpoint supercritical, final-point H1 outcome equal to development, and, if H1 is 'equal', H2 verdict and H3 outcome equal to development
iota_confirmation.opening_rule: only after the development result is committed and the three rho values are frozen in a confirmation open manifest; one opening; no re-run
iota_confirmation.if_development_unclassified: no confirmation run if the development terminal status is not 'classified'

translations_and_sizes.status: the law is translation invariant and the medium is i.i.d., so seed position is immaterial; other sizes require a separate freeze
